scripts.cloudflare:build: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck:cloudflare && PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/cot-quant-dashboard run build
scripts.cloudflare:check: pnpm run cloudflare:build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir generated-artifacts/cloudflare
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: pnpm run cloudflare:build && pnpm run cloudflare:publish-built
scripts.cloudflare:publish-built: node scripts/cloudflare-preflight.mjs && pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && pnpm exec wrangler deploy
scripts.cloudflare:test: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec tsx --test tests/cloudflare.test.ts tests/cloudflare-free.test.ts tests/sectors.test.ts
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
